clauses.clause: Route readability: Luna reaches the depot, Annex and garage without > 60 s lost (tune).
clauses.note: Fresh fixed-legend Luna low seed1 trial FAIL: ordinary depot-pickup prefix to tick990, then screenshot-only physical control. At turn2 (tick1477), Annex95m; turn17 tick5111 still95m after60.5667 active seconds (>60s). All17 original1280×720 action captures opened: the courier repeatedly hits the fenced house corner or returns to the Sunset Parcel bike; HUD alternates95/107m. No model tools, DOM, coordinates, maps or route hints. Courier protected; no teleport/skip. A17-turn batch bound deliberately stopped the controller via409 after the counterexample; that response is not a game failure.
